en: An old monochrome postcard showing a church with three domed towers topped by crosses, surrounded by a wooden fence. People walk along a cobblestone street in front of the church. There are hills and a long building to the left. Printed captions on the front identify the place and publisher: at the top right it reads "Piatra N.", at the bottom center "Biserica Sfinții trei Erarchi", and along the left edge a vertical line of text naming a local publisher.
